steps.note:
Workflow step (after a git push):
At the same time:
  1a.1. Use the run-tests skill for this session's work. All of them.
     If it worked:
       1a.1.1. Post the preview URL.
     If it failed:
       1a.1.1. Fix it and ask me.
       1a.1.2. Go on with step 1a.1.
  1a.2. Then: Update the ticket.
  1b.1. Launch a subagent with the Agent tool (general-purpose, in the background; do not wait for it) with this prompt, filled in: "Use the deploy skill for the work on branch <branch> in <worktree path>, linked to issue <#N>. Do not commit, push or switch branches unless the skill says to; at the end, report what you did." Pass on its report when it arrives.
Then carry on with what you were doing.

Workflow step (when a session starts or resumes):
At the same time:
  1a.1. Arm a monitor with the Monitor tool: command `bash '/h/monitors/ci-watch.sh' <branch>` (fill in the <...> parts), description "CI: the branch checks", timeout_ms 1200000. When it expires, arm it again, until the checks pass. On each event it emits: fix what failed
Then carry on with what you were doing.

Workflow step (when the session finishes a turn):
1. Update the ticket.
Do these before you finish this turn, then stop as you would have.

Workflow step (SQL migration edited):
1. Post the preview URL.
Then carry on with what you were doing.

Workflow step (just before a PR is created):
1. Self-review before the PR: MasterDeck does this itself and tells you when there is something to do; wait for that before moving on.
2. Then: Update the ticket.
Then carry on with what you were doing.

problems.text: Notify works after “Needs you” and “Idle” only
After command: the pattern is not a valid regular expression
After “Needs you”, only notify blocks run (a message would answer its prompt)
Built-ins run from their own hook; connect them to their trigger
Unknown trigger gone: it is not in the trigger library
Unknown monitor nope: it is not in the monitor library
Not connected to a trigger: it never runs
